Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <6cc2ou$f4e$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,
adrian...@largotim.co.uk writes

>With a bum's rush that is blocked (so as to prevent the use of the maneuver
>by the acting minion) - does the player using the rush get to replace the
>card before combat? Mel.
>

No. If that was the case then an Arson wouldn't do anything - if it was
blocked, you'd just replace it.

Do Not Replace.... means do not replace until either the action
successfully resolves (which in a Bum's Rush includes the actual combat
if it's successful) or until after the combat resulting from a block.
